results.note: In parabolam de decem virginibus (commentary on ten virgins parable): No English translation of this specific Migne text located despite searches.
Instructio sacerdotis: Pseudo-Bonaventuran work mentioned in manuscript catalogs but no published complete English translation found.
Instructio (short 658-word text): No English translation located in searches.
Jubilus rhythmicus: Attributed to Bernard of Clairvaux; portions translated into English hymns (Jesus, Thou Joy of Loving Hearts) but no complete scholarly modern English translation found.
Meditatio in Salve Regina: Despite searches, no English translation of this specific Migne work located.
Meditatio in passionem et resurrectionem Domini: This pseudo-Bernardine meditative work is known to exist but no specific published English translation of the Migne version found.
Oratio devota: No English translation located despite searches of Migne PL 184 contents.
Panegyricum ad B. Virginem Deiparam: No English translation found in searches.

Rhythmica oratio: This is Salve mundi salutare, often attributed to Bernard of Clairvaux or Arnulf of Louvain. Portions appear as O Sacred Head Now Wounded (James W. Alexander/Paul Gerhardt translation, 1830s) but no complete scholarly modern English translation documented.
Rhythmus de contemptu mundi: Complete English translation by Ronald E. Pepin, Scorn for the World (1991); also portions as hymns by John Mason Neale (O Sacred Head, Jesus the Very Thought).
Soliloquium: References to Bonaventure's Soliloquium and Hugh of Saint-Victor's work found, but no specific English translation of the Migne PL 184 version located.
Vitis mystica: Public-domain English translation by W.R.B. Brownlow (1873), attributed to Bonaventure; available on Internet Archive.
Admonitio: While Admonitio ad filium spiritualem exists with English translation (James Francis LePree, 2010), no confirmation this specific PL 185 work is that same text.
Appendix ad Diatribam: No English translation located in searches of Migne PL 185.
Chronicon Claraevallense: No English translation found; editions exist in Latin and French.
Descriptio Claraevallensis: English translation by Pauline Matarasso in The Cistercian World: Monastic Writings of the Twelfth Century (Penguin Classics).
Diatriba de illustri genere S. Bernardi: No English translation located despite searches.
Liber VII: No English translation located in searches of Migne PL 185 medieval autobiographies.
Vita S. Petri: Various medieval vitae of Peter exist; no English translation of this specific Migne version located.
Vita altera: No English translation located for this PL 189 work.
Hymnus de S. Thoma: References found to hymns of St. Thomas (Apostle and Aquinas); unclear if this PL 190 work has specific English translation.
Passio II S. Thomae Cantuariensis: No full English translation of this Migne PL 190 version of Thomas Becket's passion located.
Passio S. Thomae Cantuariensis: Various Latin editions (Giles ed. 1846) exist but no complete English translation of this specific passion found.
Prologus et initium vitae S. Thomae: No English translation located for this Migne PL 190 Thomas Becket text.
Vita IX S. Thomae Cantuariensis: No English translation found despite searches for Thomas of Canterbury vitae.
Vita et passio S. Thomae Cantuariensis: Multiple Latin versions of Thomas Becket vitae exist but no English translation of this specific Migne version located.
Compendium Speculi charitatis: No results found in searches for English translation of this work.
Notitia et fragmenta: Work appears in PL 196 (Richard of Saint Victor) but no English translation located.

Continuata belli sacri historia: This is the Latin Continuation of William of Tyre. Complete English translation by James H. Kane and Keagan J. Brewer, Routledge, Crusade Texts in Translation series (September 2024).
Aliud chronicon S. Michaelis: No English translation found; French editions exist.
Chronicon S. Michaelis: No English translation located; known in German and French editions.
De abbatibus Montis S. Michaelis: English translation (On the Abbots of Le Mont Saint-Michel) appears in Haskins Society Journal 22, edited and translated by medieval scholars.
Annales: Small text (2,339 words) in PL 204; no English translation located.
Vita S. Wilhelmi: No English translation located; likely life of St. William but specific Migne version not identified in searches.
De capta urbe Constantinopolitana: Relates to 1204 Fourth Crusade; other accounts (Gunther of Pairis) have translations but not this specific text.
Dialogus de conflictu amoris Dei et linguae dolosae: No English translation located despite searches.
Epistola ad Hugonem: No English translation found in searches.
Explanatio orationis Dominicae: Various medieval Lord's Prayer commentaries exist (Aquinas, etc.) but no specific English translation of this Migne version located.
Explanatio symboli apostolici: Medieval Apostles' Creed commentary (1150-1250) available in Latin at Documenta Catholica Omnia but no English translation found.
Ludus paschalis de adventu et interitu antichristi: Medieval Easter drama; no specific English translation of this variant located.

De diversis ordinibus Ecclesiae: This is the Libellus de Diversis Ordinibus et Professionibus. English translation with Latin parallel text by Giles Constable and Bernard S. Smith, Oxford Medieval Texts (1972).
Gesta Innocentii III: Complete English translation by James M. Powell (The Deeds of Pope Innocent III), Catholic University of America Press (2004).
Excerpta de rebus Gallicis: No English translation located in searches.
Ad pastores in synodo congregatos: No complete English translation of this Migne PL 184 work located.
Chronicon: Anonymous chronicle in PL vol. 3; no English translation located in searches.
